title: The World Of The Unseen 2 Differences Between Inspiration And Revelation

questions.question: Why does the passage say Allah speaks to people?
questions.answer: Because people are weak, needy, worried, and looking for their Lord.

questions.question: Which people are especially mentioned as receiving this message?
questions.answer: The people most loved and most in need.

questions.question: What do people want very much, according to the passage?
questions.answer: They want to find their Lord and Master.

questions.question: What do many heavenly messages together prove?
questions.answer: They strongly show Allah is real and One.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how strong this proof is?
questions.answer: Light from the sun.

questions.question: Is the proof from heavenly messages shown as weak or strong?
questions.answer: Very strong.

questions.question: After this, what did the traveler look at next?
questions.answer: Inspiration.

questions.question: How is inspiration like revelation?
questions.answer: It is similar in some ways and is a kind of speech from Allah.

questions.question: Which is higher in rank: revelation or inspiration?
questions.answer: Revelation.

questions.question: What usually brings revelation?
questions.answer: Angels.

questions.question: How does inspiration usually come?
questions.answer: More directly.

questions.question: In the king example, what is the first way of giving an order?
questions.answer: Sending a messenger with the signs of kingship.

questions.question: In the king example, what is the second way of speaking?
questions.answer: Speaking privately about a smaller personal matter.

questions.question: What does the second king example help us understand about inspiration?
questions.answer: It is a more private kind of speech.

questions.question: When Allah speaks through revelation, which great titles are mentioned?
questions.answer: Sustainer of all worlds and Creator of the universe.

questions.question: When Allah speaks in a more private way, who receives that speech?
questions.answer: Living creatures in a way that fits each one.

questions.question: What is one big difference between revelation and inspiration in the second difference?
questions.answer: Revelation is pure and special, but inspiration is more general and mixed in different ways.

questions.question: Who can receive kinds of inspiration named in the passage?
questions.answer: Angels, people, and animals.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s words by using the sea example?
questions.answer: Allah’s words are so many that the sea could not finish writing them.

questions.question: What human feelings and needs are listed in the passage?
questions.answer: Weakness, wanting things, need, worry about later, love, and worship.

questions.question: Why does the passage say Allah tells people about Himself?
questions.answer: Because they need Him and want to know Him.

questions.question: Which group is described as very anxious and needy?
questions.answer: Human beings who seek their Lord.

questions.question: What does Allah make known through His speech?
questions.answer: His own existence.

questions.question: What do the heavenly messages agree on?
questions.answer: That Allah exists and is One.

questions.question: What comparison shows the strength of that agreement?
questions.answer: It is stronger than knowing the sun from its rays.

questions.question: After learning this, what did the traveler understand about inspiration?
questions.answer: It is true and has some likeness to revelation.

questions.question: What kind of thing is inspiration called in the passage?
questions.answer: A kind of speech from the Lord.

questions.question: How does revelation usually arrive?
questions.answer: Through angels.

questions.question: How does inspiration usually arrive?
questions.answer: Directly.

questions.question: Why does the passage use a king as an example?
questions.answer: To help explain two ways of speaking.

questions.question: In the first way, how does the king send his message?
questions.answer: Through an officer or messenger with royal greatness.

questions.question: In the second way, how does the king speak?
questions.answer: By himself in a private way.

questions.question: Which king example matches revelation better?
questions.answer: The formal message sent through a messenger.

questions.question: Which king example matches inspiration better?
questions.answer: The private speaking.

questions.question: What makes revelation special in the second difference?
questions.answer: It is clear, pure, and for chosen people.

questions.question: What makes inspiration different from that?
questions.answer: It is more common and comes in many kinds.

questions.question: Name three groups mentioned that may receive inspiration.
questions.answer: Angels, humans, and animals.

questions.question: What does the ocean picture help us imagine?
questions.answer: That Allah’s words are beyond counting.

questions.question: According to the passage, what kind of people does Allah speak to?
questions.answer: People who are needy, loving, worshipping, and searching for Him.

questions.question: Why is speaking to them fitting for Allah’s Divinity in the passage?
questions.answer: Because He cares for those who need their Lord.

questions.question: What two names for Allah are people trying to find in this part?
questions.answer: Their Lord and their Master.

questions.question: What do the revelations together become in the passage?
questions.answer: A very strong proof.

questions.question: What truth do they prove together?
questions.answer: Allah exists and He is One.

questions.question: What everyday thing in the sky is used for comparison?
questions.answer: The sun.

questions.question: What did the traveler study after revelation was discussed?
questions.answer: Inspiration.

questions.question: Did the traveler see inspiration as false or true?
questions.answer: True.

questions.question: What is one way inspiration is like revelation?
questions.answer: Both are forms of speech from Allah.

questions.question: What is the main rank difference between them?
questions.answer: Revelation is higher.

questions.question: What usually stands between Allah’s message and the prophet in revelation?
questions.answer: Angels.

questions.question: What usually does not stand in the middle in inspiration?
questions.answer: Angels.

questions.question: In the story example, what does a king sometimes use to send an important order?
questions.answer: A trusted official or messenger.

questions.question: What does that important royal order show?
questions.answer: Great power and importance.

questions.question: What does the king use when speaking about a small personal matter?
questions.answer: A private way, like a trusted servant or phone.

questions.question: What does this teach about Allah’s speaking in different ways?
questions.answer: He may speak in a grand public way or a private fitting way.

questions.question: For whom is revelation reserved?
questions.answer: The elect, meaning specially chosen people.

questions.question: Why is inspiration called more general?
questions.answer: Because many kinds of creatures can receive it.

questions.question: What are the three examples of receivers of inspiration?
questions.answer: Angels, people, and animals.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the verse about the sea and ink?
questions.answer: Allah’s words do not run out.

questions.question: What does the passage say about people’s condition before speaking of Allah’s speech?
questions.answer: People are weak, needy, and worried.

questions.question: How do these needs connect to Allah’s speech?
questions.answer: They make people need to hear from their Lord.

questions.question: Which people are described as especially dear and lovable?
questions.answer: The creatures who most need and seek Allah.

questions.question: What does Allah communicate by speech in this part?
questions.answer: That He exists.

questions.question: What do the heavenly revelations all support together?
questions.answer: Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: Does the passage present this proof as smaller or greater than sunlight proving the sun?
questions.answer: Greater.

questions.question: What subject did the traveler turn to next?
questions.answer: Inspiration.

questions.question: What honest quality is given to inspiration?
questions.answer: It is called true.

questions.question: What shared feature do revelation and inspiration have?
questions.answer: Both are kinds of divine speech.

questions.question: Which one is said to be much higher?
questions.answer: Revelation.

questions.question: What usually carries revelation?
questions.answer: Angels.

questions.question: What word shows how inspiration often comes instead?
questions.answer: Directly.

questions.question: In the first king example, what makes the message look grand?
questions.answer: The royal signs and the messenger’s high place.

questions.question: Why might the king even meet with the messenger?
questions.answer: To show the greatness of his rule and command.

questions.question: In the second king example, what kind of matter is being discussed?
questions.answer: A private or small matter.

questions.question: In the comparison, what does private speech help explain?
questions.answer: A more personal kind of divine speaking.

questions.question: How is revelation described in the second difference?
questions.answer: Clear, pure, and for special chosen ones.

questions.question: How is inspiration described there?
questions.answer: It has different shades and is for many kinds.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of Allah’s words?
questions.answer: They are extremely many.

questions.question: What image helps show that Allah’s words are beyond measure?
questions.answer: Even a whole sea of ink would not be enough.

questions.question: What needs in people are named in the fifth truth?
questions.answer: Weakness, desire, poverty, need, worry, love, and worship.

questions.question: Because of these needs, what do people most want to find?
questions.answer: Their Lord and Master.

questions.question: What does Allah share with them through speech?
questions.answer: Knowledge that He exists.

questions.question: Who are called the most anxious and needy creatures?
questions.answer: Human beings seeking Allah.

questions.question: What joins together to make a strong proof in the passage?
questions.answer: Universal and heavenly revelations.

questions.question: What do these revelations prove?
questions.answer: The Necessary Existent is One.

questions.question: What strong nature picture is used to explain this proof?
questions.answer: Rays showing the sun.

questions.question: After revelation, what other kind of message did the traveler think about?
questions.answer: Inspiration.

questions.question: Which kind sounds more personal?
questions.answer: The private one.

questions.question: In the comparison, how may Allah speak with revelation?
questions.answer: With great titles and in the name of His Lordship over all.

questions.question: How may Allah speak in another way?
questions.answer: In a private way suited to the one receiving it.

questions.question: What is the second difference between revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: Revelation is pure and special, while inspiration is broad and varied.

questions.question: Which creatures are listed as receiving inspiration?
questions.answer: Angels, humans, and animals.

questions.question: What big idea does the sea-and-ink verse support here?
questions.answer: Allah’s words are more than we can count.

questions.question: What does the fifth truth teach about why Allah speaks to people?
questions.answer: He speaks to needy people who long for Him.

questions.question: What kinds of feelings show people need Allah in this passage?
questions.answer: Wanting, worry, love, and worship.

questions.question: What kinds of hard conditions are also named?
questions.answer: Weakness and poverty.

questions.question: Who are especially eager to find their Lord, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The creatures most needy and worried.

questions.question: What does Allah make known by His speech?
questions.answer: His existence.

questions.question: What do the heavenly revelations say together about Allah?
questions.answer: He exists and He is One.

questions.question: What does the passage compare this proof to?
questions.answer: Knowing the sun from its shining rays.

questions.question: Is the proof from revelation said to be less strong or more strong than that?
questions.answer: More strong.

questions.question: What did the traveler notice when he looked toward inspiration?
questions.answer: That true inspiration is somewhat like revelation.

questions.question: What is inspiration called besides being like revelation?
questions.answer: A kind of speech from the Lord.

questions.answer: Revelation.

questions.answer: Inspiration.

questions.question: What happens in the king’s second way of speaking?
questions.answer: He speaks privately himself.

questions.question: Which of those two ways best matches revelation?
questions.answer: The grand message through a messenger.

questions.question: Which best matches inspiration?
questions.answer: The private speaking.

questions.answer: It is pure and for chosen people.

questions.question: How is inspiration described in the second difference?
questions.answer: It has many forms and reaches many kinds of creatures.
